main_text.head: PERORATIO TRIVM-PHI BIBLICI
main_text.p: EAnt nunc delicati philosophiæ gentilis amatores an pertinaces admiratores, iidemque sacrorum Bibliorum profani contemptores, & dicant, nihil philosophiæ profundioris[?] in sacro isto codice occurrere. Profecto hæc nostra delineatio abunde satis erit ad illos convincendum, inque viam rectam reducendum. Quòd si lineamenta ista, quæ ego primus ita duxi, amplificentur, magis magisque patebit verum esse illud nobis familiare: NON EST LIBER NISI SCRIPTVRA SACRA. Quidem sententia hunc triumphum obsigno, Deum precatus, ut verbi sui lucem clementer in his turbis conservet, ad nominis sui gloriam, & animæ salutem, per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, Amen.
Pag. 10. linea 11. hæc desunt subjici verba in med.

page.notes: The line "EAnt" carries a large initial E; read as printed. "profundioris[?]" is doubtful: the word before "in" is partly blotted. "Profopographia" is printed that way. The errata lines are in small, rough type; "med." and "subjici" are read with some doubt. The index page numbers are printed right-aligned after leader-free spacing. No catchword or signature is visible.
